`canShowAlternatives` is unchanged: `!!featureFlags[FEATURE_FLAGS.PRODUCT_ANALYTICS_CHART_ALTERNATIVES] && isEditableSurface && isTrends && !!query && !!trendsSource`. The feature-flag, trends-only and query-shape gating apply the same in both modes.

result:
The chart type gallery now shows on the insight page in view mode too, in place of the plain dropdown. I haven't run the tests or the app, so this is untested.

The change is in `chartAlternativesLogic.ts`. The `isEditableSurface` selector required `editMode` to be true, and that was what forced view mode back to the dropdown. I removed that condition. Every other guard is unchanged, so embedded views, shared insights, dashboard tiles, missing edit permission, the feature flag, and non-trends insights all still get the dropdown. Edit mode behaves as before.

Viewers without edit permission on an insight still see the old dropdown, not a disabled gallery button. I left it that way to stay minimal. Say if you want a disabled gallery there instead.

I didn't add a test. `ChartAlternatives.test.tsx` only covers edit mode, and a view-mode case there would be the natural addition.
